simple.meaning: מִבְחָר (mibchâr) is a Hebrew word meaning “select , i.e. best.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִבְחָר (H4005) appears 13 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 23:6, with occurrences in Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, 2 Kings, Isaiah, and 3 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִבְחָר (H4005) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִבְחָר (H4005) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִבְחָר (mibchâr) / H4005 is traced through Genesis 23:6, Exodus 15:4, Deuteronomy 12:11, 2 Kings 19:23 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”

He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea.

By your messengers, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots, I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon, and I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees; and I will enter into his farthest lodging place, the forest of his fruitful field.
Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.

Take the choice of the flock,

I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol† Sheol is the place of the dead. with those who descend into the pit. All the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the lower parts of the earth.

So the king of the north will come and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city. The forces of the south won’t stand, neither will his chosen people, neither will there be any strength to stand.

definitions.full: H4005. mibchar [ מִבְחָר ] noun [masculine] ( feminine Ezek 24:5 ) choicest, best , construct מִבְחַר Deut 12:11 10 t.; suffix מִבְחָרָיו Dan 11:15 ; vows Deut 12:11 ; valleys Isa 22:7 ; fir trees 37:24 ; cedars Jer 22:7 ; bones Ezek 24:4 ; sepulchres Gen 23:6 (P); of the flock Ezek 24:5 ; of the Assyrians 23:7 ; captains Exod 15:4 (E poetry); young men Jer 48:15 ; לבנון וטוב מבחר Ezek 31:16 (strike out ᵐ5 וטוב Co); מִבְחָרָיו עַם Dan 11:15 = his choice troops .
